name: Gumroad
one_liner: Creator commerce platform with a REST API (v2) covering products, sales, subscribers, payouts, offer codes, licenses, webhooks (resource subscriptions) and hosted MCP endpoints.
auth_notes: Create an application in account advanced settings for client ID/secret (OAuth), or generate an access token for own account; tokens do not expire until revoked (help article cited by first pass).
access_notes: Applications and access tokens are created in any seller account's settings; no approval step or plan gate found. Gumroad charges per-sale fees, not API fees.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve tokens/OAuth, v2 API with many resources, webhooks via resource_subscriptions, vendor-run MCP endpoints. Endpoint count (~120) is estimated from routes.rb.

needs_human_reason: gumroad.com/api and help pages are JS shells; endpoint count estimated from vendor GitHub routes file; rate limits unknown; auth/no-approval inferred from first-pass help article.

access.quote: # API routes used in both api.gumroad.com and gumroad.com/api

buildability.quote: Gumroad is an e-commerce platform that enables creators to sell products directly to consumers.

disputes.why: L1 and help article indicate OAuth app plus access tokens; routes show oauth token endpoints.
No approval or plan gate found; tokens self-generated in account settings.
Vendor repo routes serve /.well-known/mcp.json and per-client /v1/mcp endpoints on gumroad.com.
v2 routes include resource_subscriptions with test_event.
routes.rb v2 scope lists dozens of resources; est. ~120 endpoints.
Self-serve credentials, documented API, standard auth, no blocker.
